blocks.label: Hand-off prompt
blocks.text:
You're picking up as my claude-settings advisor from a chat on another account (Oct 19–20). You can't see that chat. Your project instructions still apply. Everything durable is on the roadmap page, so start there.

1. Read the page first. The data lives in its database, not its HTML. Use ArtifactData on https://claude.ai/artifact/W7oM1YhRgsgDUw86N5VSLx:
   - collection "steps" (41+ steps; fields: phase, order, status todo/active/done/blocked, title, why, note, ask)
   - meta/cull (cull scoreboard: baseline and batches), meta/advisor (hand-off guide)
   - collection "topics" (reference findings; t17 holds this hand-off)
   Re-read a document right before you change it, and pin every write with if_version. Never say you filed something until the write has come back committed. The last chat broke this once.

2. Repo access. claude-settings is public. Call add_repo (owner shivinate7, repo claude-settings, access read), then clone shallow as it says and fetch more depth when you need history. You can measure files and history, but you can't see PR states, CI runs or comments. Say "unknown" for those, or ask me to paste them. Don't push. Write briefs for my Claude Code sessions instead.

3. Where things stand (measured Oct 20, main at 84d4076, #528):
   - The cull is closed: my ruling, Oct 19 at 10:18 am, on its time box. It ran as "Cull batch 1A–6" (#499–#508). Regular batches use a separate numbering ("Batch 4/5", "batch-oct19x"), so don't mix them up.
   - Main now: 100 decision files, 47 debt files, 49,261 hooks/*.py lines (17,441 of them code, the rest tests), 2,399 CLAUDE.md words. Baseline: 134 / 364 / 47,196 / 2,290. Debts went into debts/notes.md (514 one-line notes). Nothing loads that file into sessions.
   - Counting method: decisions/ files minus README; debts/ files minus README and notes.md; all hooks/*.py lines, tests included; `wc -w CLAUDE.md`. Report hook code and tests separately too.
   - Done Oct 19–20: the no-incident exception was deleted from building-guard-needs-incident (c11). Builders now run a mutation harness once before pushing a guard change (c12). The janitor sweep runs fetch --prune (c3). Branch cleanup took origin from 240 heads to 26, and the merge step now deletes absorbed lane branches (c4). The map skill merged in #525 (o6).

4. Open items, in order:
   - Next big step: the shared folder layout in claude-settings (o2). The map has merged, so it's unblocked. It should start with a brief.
   - Housekeeping: close #457 and delete batch-map, which adds nothing over main. Confirm #384 is closed (I approved that Oct 19), then mark c5 done.
   - Unknowns to ask a session for: the wall time of one mutation-harness run (c12), the janitor's red-then-green test and its q_max keep-reason counts (c3), and where the list of deleted branch names was saved (c4).
   - Watch regrowth (c10). Debt files went 16 → 27 → 47 in two days. New guard lanes should name an incident; #528 does.
   - Parallel, no repo needed: the reply-style draft (c7) and the Mac sandbox trial (c8).
   - Hook code is the one number the cull never moved. It needs its own plan.

5. Lessons from the last chat:
   - A session can't see this chat. Any brief that relies on my ruling must state the ruling, its time and the acts it covers. One session paused a batch because the brief didn't.
   - Rules that apply only to claude-settings go in agents/*.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md, not the root CLAUDE.md, which loads in every repo.
   - Check the repo before trusting older numbers on the page. On Oct 19 the page said "debts flat", but the sweep had already run.
   - Branch deletion and other irreversible acts: save names and tips first, and skip protected and recent branches.

Start by reading the page, pulling claude-settings, and telling me in a few lines whether anything on the page disagrees with the repo. Then ask what I want to work on.

points: Written Oct 20, 11:55 am, when the advisor chat moved to another account. Refresh the numbers in section 3 before reusing it.
